assets.title: The CC BY Song

assets.notes: The upload's primary file (order 0, the complete 2:22 mix), bundled unmodified; the model analyzes only the first ~7.8 s window (the song sings from the first bar). The same ccMixter upload publishes separate CC BY stem assets ('CC BY Vox' _3.mp3, 'CC BY Guitars' _4.mp3, 'CC By Bass' _1.mp3, each 2:25) which are NOT bundled — the demo separates the complete mix on-device. assets.title: LibriSpeech test-clean utterance 61-70968-0000 (16 kHz mono derivative)
assets.creator: Vassil Panayotov, Guoguo Chen, Daniel Povey, Sanjeev Khudanpur (LibriSpeech corpus, OpenSLR SLR12)
contributors: Underlying public-domain audiobook: 'Robin Hood' (LibriVox), chapter 4 (OpenSLR chapter 70968)
assets.derivation: Derived from the corpus's original FLAC test-clean/61/70968/61-70968-0000.flac by lossless PCM conversion to 16 kHz mono 16-bit WAV (no content edit; 4.91 s). Reference transcript (61-70968.trans.txt): 'HE BEGAN A CONFUSED COMPLAINT AGAINST THE WIZARD WHO HAD VANISHED BEHIND THE CURTAIN ON THE LEFT'.
assets.attribution: LibriSpeech ASR corpus (OpenSLR SLR12), test-clean utterance 61-70968-0000, reader Paul-Gabriel Wiener — CC BY 4.0
assets.notes: Neutral ASR validation fixture ONLY: fetched by scripts/validate-music-source-separation.mjs to prove the multi-model route's whisper-tiny.en worker genuinely transcribes real speech (anti-stub health check). Family-local replacement for a previous cross-family dependency on another family's sample; no shipped route plays or references this clip.
